name: Panera Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup (Cup with Soft Egg Noodles)
whyItWorks: Clear chicken broth simmered with tender diced white-meat chicken, softened enriched egg ribbon noodles, and tender diced carrots. Hydrating, warm, low in fiber, and comforting on sensitive bowels.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a cup or bowl of Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup with a soft French Baguette on the side. Avoid the bread bowl.
